_comment: Blank client settings. Copy to <client-id>.json, replace every value, then run build/build.sh <client-id>. Text in [brackets] shows on the slides until you replace it.
tariff_category: [Tariff category, from the site's electricity bill]
tariff_note: Placeholder: replace with the landed ₹/kWh from the site's electricity bill.
soil_cbr_note: Placeholder: replace with the soaked CBR from the site's soil test. Under 8 uses 100 mm WMM; 8 or more uses 50 mm.
why_points: Roofs carry plant, tanks and access; walkways are open sky that is paved anyway.
People walk on the power plant every day: sustainability goals made tangible.
Every tile is metered and sensed, with a live dashboard.
A pilot of 20-25 m², low-voltage DC, built in days; decide on rollout with measured data.
site_requirements: A sunny 10-14 m stretch of walkway, about 2 m wide, with little shade from 9 am to 4 pm
A low-voltage connection point within about 30 m
Permission for a 2-3 day installation window and a safety induction
A soaked CBR test of the subgrade at the pilot stretch (done at the site walk, one test per 25 m²)
A facilities contact for monthly readings and the 3-month review
deck_tagline: A pilot walkway that generates power on your campus
